name: Berklee General Scholarship (Berklee Valencia graduate)
amount_detail: "Amount varies, multiple awards". Berklee states over $1.5m in merit- and need-based scholarship funds for graduate applicants at the Valencia campus. Total of ALL Berklee awards to one student is capped: "the total amount of all Berklee scholarship awards cannot exceed 90 percent of the tuition". Exact typical award NOT FOUND on the page.
currency: USD (Berklee Valencia states graduate tuition and its fixed-sum awards in USD; wave 1 recorded tuition USD 50,430 + fees for 2026/27). Percentage awards are expressed as % of tuition.
covers: Tuition only. "scholarship awards may not be used to pay the tuition deposit or any other non-tuition-related costs"; award "divided equally into three parts and applied directly to each semester's tuition bill".
eligibility_verbatim: "Scholarship Eligibility All applicants are eligible to apply for available Berklee scholarships." / "Eligibility: All master's degree applicants" / "Awarded to outstanding applicants accepted to any master's degree program on the Valencia campus."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: No nationality or residency exclusion appears on the page. The only nationality-linked sentence is a US-specific add-on: "In addition to applying for a scholarship from Berklee, we encourage all U.S. citizens and permanent US residents to submit the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA)."
deadline_2027_intake: Scholarship deadline is tied to the admissions round, NOT to the intake date: "If you submit your program application for early action (November 1), the scholarship deadline is November 15. If you submit your program application for regular action (January 15), the scholarship deadline is February 1." For a September 2027 start that means programme application 1 Nov 2026 / scholarship 15 Nov 2026 (early), or programme application 15 Jan 2027 / scholarship 1 Feb 2027 (regular). Exact 2027-intake dates NOT YET PUBLISHED as such - dates quoted are the standing cycle text on the page.
tied_to_institution: Berklee College of Music Valencia campus ONLY - merit aid attached to admission. It cannot be applied for independently and cannot be taken to another school.
notes: NOT automatic in the loose sense: a SEPARATE scholarship application must be filed, but it is a single form that then considers you for every award. "In order to apply for a Berklee scholarship, students must submit the Berklee Graduate Scholarship Application by the deadline. The Berklee Graduate Scholarship Application will appear in the Next Steps section of your online portal once you submit your program application." "All applicants who apply for a scholarship will automatically be considered for all scholarships listed below, depending on eligibility." Decision timing: "Applicants receive a scholarship decision after acceptance into a master's degree program. Applicants not accepted to the program will not receive a scholarship decision." Both merit AND need are assessed: "awarded to candidates demonstrating the highest musical and/or academic merit together with financial need." Conditions attach: "Students who receive scholarships are required to meet a series of terms and conditions relating to attendance, academics, and conduct in order to keep their award during the academic year." Note the 90% cap is the effective MAXIMUM for any combination of Berklee awards. Relevant programmes for this candidate: MM Music Production, Technology and Innovation (MPTI); MA Global Entertainment and Music Business (GEMB); MM Scoring for Film, TV and Video Games.

name: BECASAIE - Becas de Alta Especializacion y de Formacion o Ampliacion de Estudios Musicales
funder: AIE, Sociedad de Artistas Interpretes o Ejecutantes de Espana (Fondo Asistencial y Cultural)
amount_detail: 2026/27 convocatoria: 34 BECASAIE de Alta Especializacion plus 111 BECASAIE de Formacion o Ampliacion de Estudios Musicales (over 170 becas total per AIE's own announcement). Alta Especializacion amounts by centre: Berklee College of Music (Boston) 'de hasta 6.000 EUR'; Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts (LIPA) 'de hasta 10.000 EUR' (the largest); Escuela Superior de Musica Reina Sofia 'de hasta 6.000 EUR'; Conservatori Superior de Musica del Liceu 'de hasta 6.000 EUR'; ESMUC 'de hasta 2.000 EUR'; Universidad Alfonso X El Sabio 'de hasta 6.000 EUR'; Centros de ensenanza musical no oficial en Espana y el extranjero 'de hasta 6.000 EUR'; Master AIE en gestion de grupos musicales 'de hasta 5.000 EUR'. Formacion/Ampliacion line: 'con una dotacion de hasta 1.000 EUR'. Cumulative to date: '4.676 BECASAIE por importe de 5.820.300 EUR'.
covers: Study costs. 'En el caso de las BECASAIE destinadas a escuelas de libre eleccion, es condicion indispensable que los gastos de educacion asciendan, al menos, a un 60% del importe de la Beca.' Where AIE has a collaboration agreement with the school, 'AIE tramitara el pago correspondiente a las becas directamente con el centro de estudios.'
eligibility_verbatim: "Podra optar a la concesion de una beca cualquier estudiante o profesional de la musica en activo, con independencia del instrumento o modalidad objeto de estudio, incluyendo la voz, direccion de orquesta o las nuevas tecnologias."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: "Tanto los estudiantes como los profesionales deben tener la nacionalidad espanola o de otro pais de la Union Europea, o la de un pais latinoamericano y ser residentes legales en Espana." (Convocatoria BECASAIE 2026/27, seccion 1 REQUISITOS PARA LOS SOLICITANTES, https://www.aie.es/wp-content/uploads/Folleto-BECASAIE-26-Esp.pdf). This is a DOUBLE barrier and Tunisia clears neither limb: Tunisia is not an EU member state and is not a Latin American country, so the nationality test fails outright; and the candidate has no prior Spanish residency, so the conjunctive 'y ser residentes legales en Espana' fails as well. Second exclusion, relevant if the position ever changed: "Es requisito indispensable para los becarios de Alta Especializacion no estar en posesion de una beca de otra entidad." - i.e. an Alta Especializacion beca cannot be stacked with any other body's scholarship.
deadline_2027_intake: For curso 2026/27 the published deadline was "El plazo para presentar la solicitud y documentacion finalizara el 31 de Marzo de 2026, a las 18.00", with "A partir del 11 de julio de 2026, AIE informara a los solicitantes de la concesion o no de la beca". The equivalent 2027/28 convocatoria is NOT YET PUBLISHED; do not assume 31 March 2027 - AIE reissues the folleto annually.
tied_to_institution: Not tied to one school, but tied to a LIST of named centres for the Alta Especializacion line (Berklee, LIPA, Reina Sofia, Liceu, ESMUC, UAX) plus an open 'libre eleccion' line for non-official music schools in Spain and abroad. Applied for directly to AIE, independently of any admission process.
notes: This is the single most painful exclusion in this block: BECASAIE explicitly funds Berklee College of Music at up to 6.000 EUR and covers 'las nuevas tecnologias' as a study modality, so on subject matter it is an exact fit for this candidate's Berklee Valencia / music-technology target - and the nationality clause closes it completely. AIE membership is NOT required for the general lines (the eligibility sentence says 'cualquier estudiante o profesional de la musica en activo'); membership appears only in one carve-out, '5 BECASAIE ... destinadas a Socios de AIE mayores de 35 anos'. So joining AIE would not cure the problem - the barrier is nationality plus Spanish legal residency, not membership. THE ONE THING THAT COULD CHANGE THIS: the clause requires nationality of Spain/EU/Latin America AND legal residency in Spain. If the candidate were already resident in Spain on a student visa he would satisfy the residency limb but STILL fail the nationality limb. Verdict NO is therefore stable across the whole timeline, not merely 'not yet'. Note the Berklee line names the BOSTON campus, not Valencia - a human should confirm with becas@aie.es whether Berklee Valencia is covered, though it is moot given the exclusion.

amount_detail: "Los solicitantes podran optar a una beca integral de hasta 9.000 euros, destinada a cubrir gastos como los de matricula, estancia, viaje o manutencion durante el curso completo." exclusion_clause_verbatim: NO nationality clause was found. The gate is MEMBERSHIP: only SGAE author-members may apply. SGAE membership is itself open to non-Spaniards and non-residents - SGAE's own site states "Si tu lugar de residencia es fuera de Espana, sea cual sea tu nacionalidad, tambien podemos gestionar tus derechos en el mundo" and "SGAE cuenta con mas de 127.000 socios y socias, 6.600 de los cuales residen fuera de Espana", with an initial cost of "15 euros; unico pago que se debe realizar en la entidad". Two further conditions reported for the 2024/25 edition and NOT yet verified verbatim against the bases PDF: that the applicant must master the language of instruction, and that the course of study must take place in a country different from the applicant's country of residence.
deadline_2027_intake: NOT PUBLISHED for the 2027/28 cycle. The 2024/25 edition closed 17 May 2024. The programme is described as having been 'retomado' (revived) rather than running continuously, so a human must confirm the scheme is live at all for 2027/28 before counting on it.
tied_to_institution: None - portable to 'escuelas oficiales de todo el mundo'. Applied for through Fundacion SGAE, independently of admission.
notes: REAL BUT SLOW PATH, and the only Spanish music-industry body in this block that a Tunisian can actually reach. The route is: join SGAE as an author-member first (15 EUR one-off, open to any nationality resident anywhere), establish an authorial catalogue, then apply under 'creacion de musicas populares'. Two things a human must check before relying on it: (1) whether the residence-country rule bites - the scheme funds SGAE members studying OUTSIDE their country of residence, which for a Tunisia-resident applicant studying in Spain should be satisfied, but the scheme's intent is plainly Spanish creators going abroad and this reading is UNCONFIRMED; (2) whether a master's in music technology counts as 'ampliacion de estudios' in 'creacion de musicas populares' - the categories are creation-oriented, not technology-oriented. PROVENANCE WARNING: fundacionsgae.org returns HTTP 202 with a bot challenge to automated fetching (curl and WebFetch both returned empty bodies), so the verbatim quotes above come from the SEARCH INDEX of fundacionsgae.org pages, not from pages directly read. source_access: search index - page returns 202 challenge, not directly fetched. This scheme needs a human to open the bases PDF in a normal browser. Note also that FUNDACION AUTOR, which the orchestrator asked about separately, is the legacy SGAE-group foundation whose activity has been absorbed into Fundacion SGAE - its old domain fundacionautor.org still surfaces this same becas announcement, so it is recorded here rather than as a separate live funder.

name: NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship Program
amount_detail: "funding in the amount of up to $60,000 per award". "The amount of the award is based on the individual student's actual costs of stipend, tuition and mandatory fees." "Amount of the award cannot exceed stipend, tuition, and mandatory fees."
covers: "an unrestricted gift to be used to further the student's research over the academic year", covering stipend, tuition and mandatory fees. "Awards are issued to the university for disbursement, not directly to the student" / "the award must be administered through the student's university; payment will be made to the university, not directly to the student".
eligibility_verbatim: "Students must have already completed their first year of PhD level studies (at the time of application)" / "Students must have majors in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, System Architecture, Electrical Engineering, or a related area" / "Students must be engaged in active research as part of their PhD thesis" / "Students must be enrolled as a full time active PhD student during the 2026-2027 academic year (9 months) of the award" / "Students must be available to complete an in-person summer internship prior to the start of their Fellowship year at one of NVIDIA's research offices in the United States, Canada, Germany, Sweden, Finland, Switzerland, Israel, and Taiwan."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: Excluded by DEGREE LEVEL, not by nationality. NVIDIA is explicit that nationality is not a bar: "Are International PhD students eligible? Yes. International students are eligible to apply. Keep in mind, the Graduate Fellowship Award amount may vary by country, region or location, and while NVIDIA has many international offices, we can only support fellowship internships in the United States, Canada, Germany, Sweden, Finland, Switzerland, Israel, and Taiwan." The bar is that the scheme is PhD-ONLY and requires a full year of PhD study already completed at application: "Students must have already completed their first year of PhD level studies (at the time of application)". A master's applicant cannot apply. Note also that SPAIN IS NOT on the list of countries where NVIDIA can host the mandatory internship, and "If selected for an award, a completed internship at NVIDIA is required before the Fellowship award year can begin" - so even a future PhD in Spain would have to travel to one of the eight listed countries. Also: "Full-time NVIDIA employees and immediate family of NVIDIA employees cannot participate."
deadline_2027_intake: Not applicable to a master's intake. For reference, the most recent published cycle closed "3pm Pacific Time, September 15, 2025" for the student application, with recommendation letters due "12noon Pacific Time, September 15, 2025" (three hours earlier).
tied_to_institution: None by name, but the award must be administered by the student's university and requires a thesis advisor nomination.
notes: Recorded to close the question: NVIDIA has NO master's-level scholarship. The Graduate Fellowship is a PhD research fellowship and is the only NVIDIA academic funding line found. It is worth flagging as a FUTURE option: if this candidate proceeds to a PhD in AI/ML after the master's, he would become eligible from his second PhD year onward, with no nationality bar - but the mandatory in-person NVIDIA internship excludes Spain as a host location, which is a practical complication for a Spain-based PhD. Stacking is not automatic: "Whether it is OK to combine the NVIDIA fellowship with another fellowship depends on several factors -- please contact the NVIDIA Graduate Fellowship for details".

name: Santander Open Academy scholarships (formerly Becas Santander)
funder: Banco Santander, through Santander Universidades / Santander Open Academy
amount_detail: NOT A SINGLE SCHEME - it is a catalogue of many separate calls, each with its own value. The platform organises them into four families: "Financial Assistance - Scholarships for financial assistance to support undergraduate studies and university access for those in need"; "Academic Mobility - Scholarships for national and international mobility to study at another academic institution"; "Research - Scholarships for students and faculty to support research in a specific program or project"; "Professional Internships - Scholarships to facilitate access to the job market through professional internships". Per-call amounts NOT FOUND - see provenance note.
currency: EUR (Santander calls in Spain are EUR-denominated; per-call values NOT VERIFIED here)
covers: Varies by call. Many Santander calls are short-course or language-training grants rather than tuition for a full master's - the platform's own headline is "More than 1,000 courses, content, and scholarships" and "Courses, content, and scholarships, at no cost to you."
eligibility_verbatim: "Who can apply for Santander Open Academy scholarships? The scholarships are aimed at a wide variety of profiles, from university students to professionals. Each call may have specific requirements, so review the eligibility criteria." / "Do scholarships require being a Banco Santander customer? No, in most cases it is not necessary to be a Banco Santander customer. Some calls may have particular conditions."
exclusion_clause_verbatim: NO platform-wide nationality or residency exclusion exists - and that is itself the finding. Santander explicitly devolves eligibility to each individual call: "Each call may have specific requirements, so review the eligibility criteria." The structural constraint that matters for this candidate is not nationality but SEQUENCING: the catalogue is built "With the support of leading universities, institutions and organizations", and the Academic Mobility and Financial Assistance families are addressed to students already enrolled at a partner institution. A Tunisian citizen applying from Tunisia before securing a place therefore has nothing to apply to; the same person, once matriculated at a Spanish partner university in September 2027, becomes eligible to apply to that university's Santander calls. The bank-customer question is explicitly NOT a barrier in most cases.
deadline_2027_intake: NOT FOUND - there is no single deadline. Each call publishes its own window on the Santander Open Academy platform, and calls open and close continuously through the year.
tied_to_institution: Mostly yes in practice - the majority of calls are run WITH a specific partner university and are open to that university's own students. Application is through the Santander Open Academy platform: "To apply, register on the Santander Open Academy platform, complete your profile and apply for the scholarship."
notes: ACTION POINT RATHER THAN A FUNDING SOURCE FOR THE APPLICATION STAGE. The right way to use Santander is: (1) it cannot help fund the decision to come to Spain, because nearly every call presupposes enrolment at a partner university; (2) once a Spanish university place is confirmed for September 2027, check that specific university's Santander calls immediately, because there is no nationality bar and no customer requirement; (3) when comparing Spanish universities, whether the university is a Santander Universidades partner is a genuine tie-breaker.
